items.name: dashboard
items.title: Dashboard
items.description: Dashboard page in the app frame: a period picker, KPI cards, a trend chart and a table of records, marked 示範資料. Replace the sample data with yours and drop the mark.

items.name: list-detail
items.title: List and edit drawer
items.description: A table of records with an edit drawer that asks before discarding unsaved changes.

items.name: settings
items.title: Settings page
items.description: Settings in the app frame: categories in the URL hash, switch rows, fields that save on blur, 「已儲存」, theme and accent pickers, and a danger zone last.

items.name: login
items.title: Sign-in page
items.description: A centered sign-in card with per-field errors from your sign-in check.
